_comment: Hand-entered contract terms. The MLB Stats API carries no contract data at all,
and Baseball Reference salaries thin out for the most recent seasons, so this file
is the source of truth for anything entered here — it overrides scraped salaries
and forces surplus_value to be recomputed.
match.player / match.date  the move to attach to. Reported dates routinely differ
from the league's filing date, so a player match within
14 days counts. Use "move_id" instead for an exact hit.
salary_paid                total guaranteed dollars, NOT average annual value.
contract_through           final season of the deal. Anything at or beyond the
current season marks the move as still in progress, so
the site can flag that its score is not yet a verdict.
confidence / source / note documentation only; the script ignores them.
Entries without a move_id or a player+date match (like this one) are ignored.
Any override that matches no move is reported loudly at the end of a run, and
fails CI under --strict-overrides. It is never silently dropped.

source: ESPN / MLB.com, Dec 2016 — record reliever deal, opt-out after year 3
note: Chapman opted out after 2019, so the Yankees did not pay the full $86M. Total guarantee used here.
$295M remained on Stanton's 13yr/$325M deal at the trade; Miami sent $30M back, so the Yankees assumed ~$265M net. Widely reported figures vary slightly with how the $30M offset is dated.

source: ESPN / Forbes, Dec 2019 — agreed Dec 11, finalized Dec 18

note: Reported mid-January, finalized late January; the date-tolerance window covers both.

source: MLB Trade Rumors, Mar 2022 — Yankees assumed Donaldson's remaining $50M

note: Rizzo signed 2yr/$32M in Mar 2022, opted out, then re-signed 2yr/$40M in Nov 2022. This entry is the second deal; the March 2022 one is not separately recorded.

source: MLB.com / CBS Sports — reported Dec 15, announced Dec 21, 2022
note: The API spells him "Carlos Rodón". Name matching folds accents, so either spelling works here.

source: NBC News / SI, Jan 2024 — record $31M arbitration settlement
note: Soto arrived with one year of control left. The $31M is his 2024 salary, agreed in Jan 2024 and charged here against the trade that acquired him.

source: ESPN / NBC Sports, Dec 2024 — largest deal ever for a left-handed pitcher
MLB Trade Rumors, Dec 2024 — Cubs covered $2.5M of the salary
note: Bellinger had ~$27.5M left (2025 salary plus a 2026 player option buyout); Chicago paid $2.5M. He opted out after 2025, so the Yankees' actual outlay on this trade is approximate.
Dollar figure is well sourced; the exact signing date is less certain, hence the tolerance window.

source: MLB Trade Rumors / Pinstripe Alley, Nov 2025 — accepted the qualifying offer
note: Qualifying-offer acceptances are recorded inconsistently in the transactions feed; this one is the likeliest to come back unmatched.
$20M signing bonus, $32.5M in 2026-27, $25.8M in 2028-29, $25.9M in 2030; opt-outs after 2027 and 2028.
